name: Vidarbha Dairy Belt Silage Pilot Observations
purpose: Ground truth repository for genuine on-farm pilot trials across dairy clusters
geographic_region: Nagpur, Amravati, Wardha districts, Maharashtra, India

schema.sampling_depth_cm: Depth of probe insertion in cm
schema.ph: Measured pH value or null if uncalibrated
schema.moisture: Estimated or measured moisture % or null
schema.expert_label: Sensory triage label: Safe | Caution | Unsafe
schema.lab_result: Laboratory wet-chemistry result or null if pending
schema.label_source: Source classification: EXPERT | LAB | RESEARCH | RULE | SYNTHETIC | UNKNOWN

missing_value_policy: Missing measurements must remain null and must never be filled with fabricated numbers.
scaling_strategy: The evaluation pipeline supports small cohorts (20+, 50+, 100+ samples) without requiring thousands of observations.
